ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) central regions with high-contrast low-intensity (black) peripheral margins and radiating streaks; estimated 65:35 white-to-black pixel ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous blocks occupy the medial lobe areas. Radiating low-intensity black streaks originate from the peduncle insertion point. Distinct dark-pigmented circular ocelli are visible on the lower quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an approximate pixel-calculated vertex angle of 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the primary trailing edge, characterized by sharp peaks and deep valleys; serration density increases toward the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edges with a pronounced upward and outward sweep culminating in acute lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity, multi-faceted protrusions (barnacle colonization) are concentrated on the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of vertical and diagonal high-contrast white linear streaks (rake marks) predominantly localized on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal tips resulting in irregular, bulbous geometric deformations of the natural fluke boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique twin concentric black ring patterns located on the medial surface of the left lobe.
